mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current conditions are clear and 55 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail with an air quality index of 75. Under the waxing gibbous moon, look to the sky early tomorrow at 5:45 AM, when the ISS will rise in the west near Mount Horeb and travel toward the northeast near the Madison Home Depot for three minutes. Overnight, expect a low of 45 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The City of Verona is moving forward with the Mark Drive reconstruction, having completed underground utility work with plans for final asphalt by spring. Additionally, residents can now participate in a toilet rebate program or use the Eye On Water tool to monitor hourly utility usage.

There is plenty to do in town starting with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia today. Tomorrow, you can catch live music at Paddy Mac's, yoga at Insight Wellness, or Wednesday Pizza and a Pitcher at Wisconsin Brewing Company.
The Verona Police Department reported that on Wednesday, October 15, a school bus driver was arrested for O W I, though thankfully no injuries were reported.
Today's flavor is the classic Devil's Food Cake. The store is currently open and will be serving customers until 10 PM this evening.
